universities.summary: Government College of Technology is a public, autonomous engineering college on Thadagam Road in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Affiliated to Anna University, it offers undergraduate engineering and technology degrees, postgraduate engineering specialisations and research study. First-year undergraduate entry follows Tamil Nadu’s counselling rules rather than a management-quota application.
universities.campusLifestyle: The campus combines engineering departments with a central library, digital-library access and student clubs. The library provides an online catalogue, reference collection, NPTEL and SWAYAM learning resources, reprography and career-preparation material. Academic study is supported by branch laboratories and project work rather than classroom teaching alone.
universities.cityProfile: GCT is on Thadagam Road in Coimbatore North, Tamil Nadu 641013. The college is approximately 6 km from Coimbatore railway station and 14 km from Coimbatore airport. The main teaching campus, college administration and hostels share this Coimbatore identity; do not confuse it with Coimbatore Institute of Technology, a different institution and counselling choice.
universities.practicalExposure: Electronics and Instrumentation students use Process Control, Control System, Industrial Instrumentation, Industrial Automation, and Sensors and Transducers laboratories. Industrial Biotechnology organises industrial visits and project or summer-training activity, while its Biotechnology Association runs the ELYZIA technical symposium. The undergraduate regulations combine foundation and professional subjects with electives, practical courses and project assessment; specific training requirements depend on the curriculum.
universities.hostelOverview: Men’s and women’s hostels are available. The 2026–27 hostel schedule has establishment INR 2,750, development INR 3,250, amenities INR 500 and electrical maintenance INR 500 per year. Boarding is estimated at INR 2,800 per month; the college’s eleven-month hostel-and-boarding estimate is INR 37,800. Admission deposits and room allocation are separate, so this is not an all-inclusive degree budget.
universities.dietarySupport: The 2026 TNEA college profile identifies vegetarian messes for both men’s and women’s hostels. Boarding is billed separately from tuition, with the current fee certificate using an approximate monthly figure rather than a guaranteed fixed food budget. Day scholars also have a non-residential students’ canteen.
universities.safetyOverview: GCT maintains an Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad, a Students Grievance Redressal Committee, an Internal Complaints Committee and a Women Empowerment Cell. Hostel residence is governed by separate boarding and visiting rules; students should plan around those rules rather than assume unrestricted access.
universities.studentSupport: Faculty advisers monitor academic progress and attendance under the degree regulations. The library supports self-study, competitive-exam preparation and academic referencing; grievance and equal-opportunity channels provide additional support. Students Traffic counselling can help map the correct admission route and fee category.

Working-professional, postgraduate and doctoral pathways have different entry conditions from standard first-year undergraduate admission.

faq.question: Is Government College of Technology a public institution?
faq.answer: GCT is a Tamil Nadu government engineering college in Coimbatore, established in 1945. It is autonomous and affiliated to Anna University; it is not Coimbatore Institute of Technology.

faq.question: Which undergraduate engineering fields are available?
faq.answer: Full-time study includes Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Production, Electronics and Instrumentation, Computer Science, CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Information Technology and Industrial Biotechnology. The standard first-year route lasts four years; each branch has a separate TNEA choice code.

faq.question: What language is used for teaching?
faq.answer: English is used for undergraduate courses, examinations, seminar presentations and project reports. The general entry criteria are academic and counselling requirements, not an advertised IELTS or TOEFL pathway.

faq.question: Can applicants enter immediately after Class 12?
faq.answer: The first-year academic route accepts HSC +1 and +2 or equivalent with the required Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry marks. TNEA 2026 requires 45% average for General and 40% for the listed reserved categories; specified vocational qualifications provide another route. A qualifying score alone does not guarantee allotment.

faq.question: How does the application route work?
faq.answer: Apply through TNEA and complete certificate verification before choice filling. Select Government College of Technology, Coimbatore, college code 2005, and the intended branch code. Seat allotment and confirmation follow the counselling process; GCT does not operate a management-quota route.

faq.question: Can international or other-state applicants use this route?
faq.answer: The standard TNEA route is restricted by nationality and Tamil Nadu schooling, nativity or specified parental-service rules. Narrow exceptions cover eligible Tamil Nadu native OCI/PIO applicants and Sri Lankan Tamil refugees educated in Tamil Nadu. This is not an unrestricted foreign-national admission route, and other-state applicants are not automatically eligible.

faq.question: What does undergraduate tuition cover?
faq.answer: For the non-first-graduate BC/MBC category, tuition is INR 2,000 per academic year in 2026–27. It is only one component: development, special, computer and other listed college charges bring the relevant fee-certificate amount to INR 6,780, before examinations and accommodation. First-year admission deposits and university charges must be budgeted separately.

faq.question: Are fee concessions the same as a free degree?
faq.answer: No. First-graduate and SC/ST fee schedules remove the tuition component but retain other charges; further concessions depend on the applicant category. Scholarship and tuition-concession eligibility must be matched to the actual documents and family circumstances rather than assumed from a low tuition figure.

faq.question: What accommodation and food costs should be planned?
faq.answer: Men’s and women’s hostels are available. The 2026–27 hostel certificate gives INR 7,000 a year in establishment, development, amenities and electrical-maintenance charges, with approximate boarding of INR 2,800 per month; its eleven-month hostel-and-boarding estimate is INR 37,800. Admission deposits, room allocation and any extra charges remain separate.

faq.question: How is practical learning organised?
faq.answer: Undergraduate study combines laboratory courses, branch subjects, electives and project work. Electronics and Instrumentation has Process Control, Control System, Industrial Instrumentation, Industrial Automation, and Sensors and Transducers laboratories. Industrial Biotechnology combines bioprocess-related study with industrial visits and project or summer-training activity.

faq.question: Are working-professional and postgraduate routes identical to first-year entry?
faq.answer: No. Working-professional B.E. regulations describe a seven-semester diploma-entry route in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics, and Electronics and Communication Engineering. M.E. study has a separate postgraduate selection process and a four-semester structure; neither should be treated as the standard Class 12 TNEA route.

faq.question: What recognition is verified for the college?
faq.answer: The University Grants Commission lists Government College of Technology under Sections 2(f) and 12B. Current institutional affiliation is with Anna University. Programme-specific accreditation must be interpreted by exact branch and validity period; this institutional listing does not mean every programme holds the same accreditation.

Affiliated to Anna University, it offers undergraduate engineering and technology degrees, postgraduate engineering specialisations and research study. First-year undergraduate entry follows Tamil Nadu’s counselling rules rather than a management-quota application.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official home

evidence.claimText: The campus combines engineering departments with a central library, digital-library access and student clubs. The library provides an online catalogue, reference collection, NPTEL and SWAYAM learning resources, reprography and career-preparation material. Academic study is supported by branch laboratories and project work rather than classroom teaching alone.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official library

evidence.claimText: GCT is on Thadagam Road in Coimbatore North, Tamil Nadu 641013. The college is approximately 6 km from Coimbatore railway station and 14 km from Coimbatore airport. The main teaching campus, college administration and hostels share this Coimbatore identity; do not confuse it with Coimbatore Institute of Technology, a different institution and counselling choice.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official disclosure

evidence.claimText: Electronics and Instrumentation students use Process Control, Control System, Industrial Instrumentation, Industrial Automation, and Sensors and Transducers laboratories. Industrial Biotechnology organises industrial visits and project or summer-training activity, while its Biotechnology Association runs the ELYZIA technical symposium. The undergraduate regulations combine foundation and professional subjects with electives, practical courses and project assessment; specific training requirements depend on the curriculum.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official eie

evidence.claimText: Men’s and women’s hostels are available. The 2026–27 hostel schedule has establishment INR 2,750, development INR 3,250, amenities INR 500 and electrical maintenance INR 500 per year. Boarding is estimated at INR 2,800 per month; the college’s eleven-month hostel-and-boarding estimate is INR 37,800. Admission deposits and room allocation are separate, so this is not an all-inclusive degree budget.

evidence.claimText: The 2026 TNEA college profile identifies vegetarian messes for both men’s and women’s hostels. Day scholars also have a non-residential students’ canteen.

evidence.claimText: GCT maintains an Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad, a Students Grievance Redressal Committee, an Internal Complaints Committee and a Women Empowerment Cell. evidence.claimText: Is Government College of Technology a public institution? GCT is a Tamil Nadu government engineering college in Coimbatore, established in 1945. It is autonomous and affiliated to Anna University; it is not Coimbatore Institute of Technology.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official home

evidence.claimText: Which undergraduate engineering fields are available? Full-time study includes Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Production, Electronics and Instrumentation, Computer Science, CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Information Technology and Industrial Biotechnology. The standard first-year route lasts four years; each branch has a separate TNEA choice code.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official ugreg

evidence.claimText: What language is used for teaching? English is used for undergraduate courses, examinations, seminar presentations and project reports. The general entry criteria are academic and counselling requirements, not an advertised IELTS or TOEFL pathway.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official ugreg

evidence.claimText: Can applicants enter immediately after Class 12? The first-year academic route accepts HSC +1 and +2 or equivalent with the required Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry marks. TNEA 2026 requires 45% average for General and 40% for the listed reserved categories; specified vocational qualifications provide another route. A qualifying score alone does not guarantee allotment.
evidence.sourceLabel: Directorate of Technical Education: TNEA 2026 Information Brochure

evidence.claimText: How does the application route work? Apply through TNEA and complete certificate verification before choice filling. Select Government College of Technology, Coimbatore, college code 2005, and the intended branch code. Seat allotment and confirmation follow the counselling process; GCT does not operate a management-quota route.
evidence.sourceLabel: Directorate of Technical Education: TNEA 2026 Information Brochure

evidence.claimText: Can international or other-state applicants use this route? The standard TNEA route is restricted by nationality and Tamil Nadu schooling, nativity or specified parental-service rules. Narrow exceptions cover eligible Tamil Nadu native OCI/PIO applicants and Sri Lankan Tamil refugees educated in Tamil Nadu. This is not an unrestricted foreign-national admission route, and other-state applicants are not automatically eligible.
evidence.sourceLabel: Directorate of Technical Education: TNEA 2026 Information Brochure

evidence.claimText: What does undergraduate tuition cover? For the non-first-graduate BC/MBC category, tuition is INR 2,000 per academic year in 2026–27. It is only one component: development, special, computer and other listed college charges bring the relevant fee-certificate amount to INR 6,780, before examinations and accommodation. First-year admission deposits and university charges must be budgeted separately.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official fee

evidence.claimText: Are fee concessions the same as a free degree? No. First-graduate and SC/ST fee schedules remove the tuition component but retain other charges; further concessions depend on the applicant category. Scholarship and tuition-concession eligibility must be matched to the actual documents and family circumstances rather than assumed from a low tuition figure.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official feewaiver

evidence.claimText: What accommodation and food costs should be planned? Men’s and women’s hostels are available. The 2026–27 hostel certificate gives INR 7,000 a year in establishment, development, amenities and electrical-maintenance charges, with approximate boarding of INR 2,800 per month; its eleven-month hostel-and-boarding estimate is INR 37,800. Admission deposits, room allocation and any extra charges remain separate.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official fee

evidence.claimText: How is practical learning organised? Undergraduate study combines laboratory courses, branch subjects, electives and project work. Electronics and Instrumentation has Process Control, Control System, Industrial Instrumentation, Industrial Automation, and Sensors and Transducers laboratories. Industrial Biotechnology combines bioprocess-related study with industrial visits and project or summer-training activity.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official eie

evidence.claimText: Are working-professional and postgraduate routes identical to first-year entry? No. Working-professional B.E. regulations describe a seven-semester diploma-entry route in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics, and Electronics and Communication Engineering. M.E. study has a separate postgraduate selection process and a four-semester structure; neither should be treated as the standard Class 12 TNEA route.
evidence.sourceLabel: Government College of Technology official wpreg

evidence.claimText: What recognition is verified for the college? The University Grants Commission lists Government College of Technology under Sections 2(f) and 12B. Current institutional affiliation is with Anna University. Programme-specific accreditation must be interpreted by exact branch and validity period; this institutional listing does not mean every programme holds the same accreditation.
